images.name: ahhhh
images.alt: A straight gravel road between green and golden fields at dusk; a small cartoon Gravel God, seen from behind, rides away up the road under the words "AAAAHHH!!!".
images.note: The original was a short animation (the words appear); the redraw is a still of its first frame.

images.joke: DAILY NEWS: Gravel Enthusiast bombs biggest race of the year but remains handsome.
images.alt: A newspaper front page, "DAILY NEWS", with the headline "Gravel Enthusiast bombs biggest race of the year but remains handsome." above a grinning cartoon Gravel God.

images.name: you-suck-at-cooking-you-can-barely-readd
images.joke: ...you suck at cooking, you can barely read, you can't even touch your toes, you have like 2.5 friends, you should just go die
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God rides a dirt track through bright green fields, his speech bubble reading: "...you suck at cooking, you can barely read, you can't even touch your toes, you have like 2.5 friends, you should just go die"

images.name: water-tower-of-emporia
images.alt: A grey water tower lettered EMPORIA, with a giant cartoon Gravel God head looming over it.
images.note: The original laid his face see-through over an aerial photo of Emporia; the renderer cannot do see-through figures, so the town photo is replaced by a drawn water tower with him looming above it.
